## Biographical Information

(1848-1902)

autograph hunter and accountant

He extracted autographs from Hardy and Swinburne using the same technique.[[<i>Collected Letters of Thomas Hardy</i>](../other_books/otherbook_1033.qmd), VII, 105 and [<i>The Swinburne Letters</i>](../other_books/otherbook_1032.qmd), V, 231; birth and death registers;  listed at 24 Cramer Terrace, Gateshead on Tyne, in 1891 census]
